name: East Fork Dam
title: East Fork Dam
summary: One of the dams on the Marescent Plateau, at 48.3N 76.6W. A 96 m ancient stone dam built of four 24 m blocks (crest at z 88-93) holds a reservoir (z 82) above a lower pool (z 54) and the river gorge (z 26). A giant red metal hand, 18 m tall, rises out of the reservoir 70 m east of the dam; it marks the East Fork Dam Hive.

landmarks.name: Red hand
landmarks.note: 0x0100266B in the reservoir, the East Fork Dam Hive.

site.name: East Fork Dam
site.notes: Derived @teleloc on the rocky bank 45 m north of the reservoir (ground 87.7, 8.4 m from the nearest pine, inside landblock 0x1FBC; 0x1FBD to the north is missing from the kit).

shots.standingOrder: Fly east 20 m above the dam's crest from over the lower pool, tracking the 96 m stone dam down to vertical and holding the top-down view over the reservoir; nothing within 25 m.
shots.notes: Flyover. The camera flies east at z 113, about 20 m above the dam crest and 59 m above the lower pool, tracking the 96 m ancient stone dam down to vertical. It then holds the top-down view over the still reservoir, 48 % of the edit over water, with the warm sun behind.
